race.comment: ESPECIAL KAI (1) was in the placings last time but shapes well for this on his enormous win the start prior, getting around this track over 350m in 19.14. Has the ability and looks a key chance again. EVIL EYE (7) goes very well this course and distance starting 56 times for 24 wins and 18 minors. In the money last time at this track (19.30) in a Free For All, finishing a 1.1 lengths third. Looks suited here and can measure up. ROCKET SCIENCE (4) is progressing well scoring last time out (19.22) at this track and bringing up his 8th career win. Has a good record here at this journey. Winner at his latest appearance in the quickest time on the card. Significant danger. OCCULENT (8) busted the clock to salute last start. Hard to beat again.
